_doc: RADICE dating cabinet (#46, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #22). Luigi Radice: Castello 1961 -> CAMINETTO co-founder 1968 (see caminetto.json) -> own PIPA RADICE from 1980 (sons Gianluca + Marzio; grandfather Paolo helped early). Family-workshop brand, few documented stamp cliffs -> floors + notes. SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Radice.json (family's own text) + caminetto.json cross-facts + artisan registry (Radice entry).

history_anchors._doc: Luigi Radice b.1939; first briar 1961 at Carlo Scotti's CASTELLO (Cantù). 1968: co-founds CAMINETTO ('Pipa del Baffo') with Peppino Ascorti (+ Gianni Davoli distribution; boom 1974-75). 1980: founds his own PIPA RADICE at Cucciago (CO); son Gianluca from the start; later Marzio too. House tells: faux-bamboo carved shanks, silver bands, hand-engraved save-rims (Luigi's engraving), horn accents (buffalo/moufflon/deer/roe), TWIN-BORE mouthpieces (their invention, on oil-cured pipes — NOTE: Savinelli-revival Rossi also used twinbore; different brand, no confusion in-cabinet), briar seasoned 3+ years. 'Recently introduced' ebonite mouthpieces (article era 2010s) — before that acrylic-era? unverified. Known grade/series names (from trade, not this article): Rind, Clear, Silk, Collect (XXL Rind Collect Bamboo pictured) — undated, unencoded.
